task_completion.description: Open the Rabies virus genome file (NC_001542.1) in UGENE.
task_completion.visual_evidence: UGENE window showing the file 'rabies_virus_genome.gb' or 'NC_001542.1' loaded in the Project View or Sequence View.

task_completion.description: Locate the CDS (Coding Sequence) annotations for the viral proteins.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Annotations editor or Sequence View showing CDS tracks for proteins like N, P, M, G, and L.

task_completion.description: Translate and export the CDS annotations to a FASTA file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Export' or 'Export Sequences' dialog box in UGENE with 'Translate to amino acids' selected and the output path set to 'rabies_proteome.fasta'.

task_completion.description: Verify the creation of the FASTA file with the correct protein sequences.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal showing 'rabies_proteome.fasta' containing 5 protein sequences starting with '>' headers.

task_completion.description: Create the summary text file with specific protein statistics.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor showing 'proteome_summary.txt' with the total count (5), the largest protein (L, 2142 aa), and the G protein length (524 aa).

integrity.description: The agent used the UGENE GUI for sequence processing rather than just command-line scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the UGENE interface, menus, and dialog boxes being interacted with.

integrity.description: The agent derived the protein lengths from the software/data rather than hardcoding them from memory.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent selecting annotations in UGENE and checking their properties or using the 'Statistics' panel.

integrity.description: The agent used the specific file paths requested in the task description.
integrity.visual_evidence: The export dialogs or file explorer showing the paths ~/UGENE_Data/results/rabies_proteome.fasta and ~/UGENE_Data/results/proteome_summary.txt.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The Rabies virus reference genome (NC_001542.1) contains exactly 5 CDS annotations. The resulting proteome should have 5 proteins. The largest protein is the 'L' protein (RNA-directed RNA polymerase) with a length of 2142 amino acids. The Glycoprotein (G) has an exact length of 524 amino acids.
